name: TicketLens
title: TicketLens: support-ticket intent classification and conversation summarization
description: NLP benchmark for customer support: 27-intent ticket routing (TF-IDF, MiniLM embeddings, fine-tuned DistilBERT at 99.84% accuracy) and zero-shot dialogue summarization (lead-2, BART, Flan-T5, Llama 3.2) scored with ROUGE and BERTScore on DialogSum, served with FastAPI and Gradio.
